name: airplay-receiver
description: AirPlay HD receiver for Windows 10/11 (Sprint 1: advertisement + /info + Win32/D3D11 window).

mdns.description: Apple mDNSResponder (Bonjour-compatible advertiser). Requires the MSVC MFC component - the port builds dnssd.dll/dnssd.lib fine but its dns-sd CLI tool fails with RC1015 'cannot open include file afxres.h' when MFC is absent (measured on VS 18 BuildTools). Enable with -DVCPKG_MANIFEST_FEATURES=mdns.

video.description: FFmpeg media stack (avcodec/avformat/swscale/swresample + NVDEC). Sprint 2+ only - enable with -DVCPKG_MANIFEST_FEATURES=video. Not required to configure, build or test Sprint 1 (brief v3.2, gate 2.0).
